domains.piano: Piano roll, persistent notes and MIDI references
domains.mixer: Mixer strips, built-in EQ and routing
domains.plugins: Generic plugins, calibrated controls and effect loading
domains.advanced: Expert escape hatches and UI fallback

fl_build_info.purpose: Identify the loaded build before relying on a tool or feature. This is a good always-visible entry point and does not prove FL is connected.

fl_connect.purpose: Reconnect the dedicated MIDI session and verify the controller handshake when connection diagnostics indicate a problem.

fl_connection_status.purpose: Check whether endpoints merely exist or the live FL controller actually responds. Use before live work.

fl_session_inspect.purpose: Preferred starting point for live work: inspect project identity, transport and dependencies without changing the project.

fl_workflow_catalog.purpose: Find which workflows exist, their prerequisite tools and verification limits. This is the natural root for task-oriented discovery.

fl_capabilities.purpose: Inspect the native API signatures actually advertised by the running controller. Use before an expert native call, not as a giant default prompt dump.

fl_production_inspect.purpose: Obtain fresh identity and revision evidence for guarded channel, project or step edits. Inspect the exact scope that the next write needs.

fl_project_snapshot.purpose: Broad whole-session inventory for orientation. Because it returns channels, mixer, effects and routes together, prefer narrower reads once the target is known.

fl_receipt.purpose: Resolve an uncertain or timed-out controller command before deciding whether recovery is needed. It is evidence lookup, not undo or replay.

fl_get_transport_status.purpose: Read playback, recording, position and mode before deciding whether a guarded operation can run.

fl_get_song_length.purpose: Read the host timeline duration when planning bounded playback, export or recording checks.

fl_play.purpose: Toggle playback for an audition. This is a toggle, so inspect the acknowledged state instead of repeating a request blindly.

fl_stop.purpose: Stop playback and inspect the acknowledgement. Use as the transport stop primitive where appropriate.

fl_record.purpose: Toggle the recording latch. Prefer the recording job workflow for a bounded, verified take.

fl_set_loop_mode.purpose: Select song or pattern playback, which changes what the same Play action auditions.

fl_set_song_position.purpose: Seek to a location with an explicit unit/mode. Avoid confusing normalized position, milliseconds, seconds and ticks.

fl_set_playback_speed.purpose: Change the playback multiplier. This is distinct from setting the project BPM.

fl_get_channel_count.purpose: Count the relevant Channel Rack scope. Global versus current-group indexing matters when resolving later targets.

fl_get_all_channels.purpose: Inventory Channel Rack entries, selection, mute state and mixer destinations before targeting a channel.

fl_get_channel_info.purpose: Inspect one channel when its index is known; more compact than a complete project snapshot.

fl_get_selected_channel.purpose: Discover the selected channel before a selected-target operation; explicitly handle no selection.

fl_channel_configure.purpose: Preferred guarded multi-property channel edit. Bind gain, pan, pitch, mute or routing to a fresh global-channel revision and retain the receipt.

fl_set_channel_name.purpose: Basic channel-label setter. Renaming helps later human identification but does not create a stable unique ID.

fl_set_channel_color.purpose: Basic Channel Rack color setter using RGB components; a presentation change.

fl_set_channel_volume.purpose: Basic normalized channel gain setter. Prefer the guarded configure workflow when coordinating production edits.

fl_set_channel_pan.purpose: Basic channel balance setter in -1..1; this is not the normalized 0..1 automation representation.

fl_mute_channel.purpose: Set an explicit desired mute state; null means toggle and requires special care when recovering.

fl_solo_channel.purpose: Set an explicit solo state for auditioning one source; null means toggle.

fl_select_channel.purpose: Select or deselect one global channel; other selections may remain.

fl_select_one_channel.purpose: Make one channel the sole selection before a selected-channel workflow.

fl_route_channel_to_mixer.purpose: Assign a Channel Rack source to a mixer strip. This differs from a send between two mixer strips.

fl_trigger_note.purpose: Play or release a live note for audition. It does not compose or save piano-roll notes.

fl_get_grid_bit.purpose: Read one current-pattern step when checking a specific drum hit.

fl_get_step_sequence.purpose: Read a bounded span of current-pattern steps for rhythm inspection.

fl_set_grid_bit.purpose: Set one current-pattern step. For a complete planned pattern prefer the revision-guarded step editor.

fl_set_step_sequence.purpose: Basic bulk boolean step writer. Specify the intended target and span; it is a lower-level option than the guarded editor.

fl_step_sequence_edit.purpose: Preferred guarded step-pattern replacement. Explicit total_steps determines the clearing boundary, and later steps remain preserved.

fl_background_piano_inspect.purpose: Preferred inspection for the experimental script-free FL26 score workflow. Bind the saved FLP, target channel, sound and routing before writing.

fl_background_piano_select.purpose: Switch to an existing pattern and sound with verification. It also exposes the piano roll and routed mixer target, and may save recovery copies.

fl_background_piano_write.purpose: Replace one saved FL26 score without ComposeWithLLM. Use after background inspection; it supports the documented basic note fields, not every legacy expression field.

fl_piano_roll_prepare.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Legacy piano-script activation is unavailable. Use fl_background_piano_inspect and fl_background_piano_select.

fl_get_piano_roll_info.purpose: Inspect bridge paths/protocol and pending work without triggering the FL piano script. Useful for diagnosing queues.

fl_get_piano_roll_state.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Legacy script-based piano inspection is unavailable. Use fl_background_piano_inspect.

fl_send_notes.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Legacy score delivery is unavailable. Use fl_background_piano_write for persistent notes.

fl_send_chord.purpose: Convenience note-writing transaction for simultaneous pitches. It still needs the same target and verification discipline as other persistent notes.

fl_delete_notes.purpose: Delete matching pitches/times while retaining other notes. Specify exact matches and inspect the resulting score.

fl_clear_piano_roll.purpose: Clear notes from the inspected roll with recovery information. This is destructive musical editing, even though markers are preserved.

fl_trigger_script.purpose: Execute an already prepared piano request or refresh the queue. Correlation with the matching response matters more than a generic success flag.

fl_clear_request_queue.purpose: Acknowledge completed bridge work. It deliberately refuses to discard unresolved requests or recovery evidence.

fl_write_pattern_bank.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Legacy script-based pattern-bank writing is unavailable. Use native background piano tools or saved-FLP editing.

fl_midi_reference_search.purpose: Find and summarize local MIDI examples by filenames or musical fingerprints. Search completeness and musical relevance are separate questions.

fl_notes_transform.purpose: Propose deterministic transposition/quantization while retaining supported expression. It returns notes for review and never applies them to FL itself.

fl_get_mixer_track_count.purpose: Read mixer capacity, including Master. A capacity count does not mean every strip contains useful material.

fl_get_all_mixer_tracks.purpose: Inventory occupied strips, or include empty strips when planning destinations.

fl_get_mixer_track_info.purpose: Read one strip and its gain/dB values before a targeted change.

fl_mixer_scene.purpose: Preferred guarded balance edit across named strips. Supports explicit dB targets and a receipt, unlike a sequence of basic normalized setters.

fl_set_track_volume.purpose: Basic mixer gain setter: unity is 0.8, not 1.0. Use observed dB or the scene tool for a musical level target.

fl_set_stereo_separation.purpose: Adjust FL stereo separation on one strip. It is not a general stereo-imaging analysis or mid/side processor.

fl_set_track_name.purpose: Rename a strip for readable targeting; inspect current identities again after changes.

fl_set_track_color.purpose: Set mixer label color from RGB values.

fl_mute_track.purpose: Set a desired mixer mute state. Null invokes a toggle, so retries can reverse the intended result.

fl_solo_track.purpose: Solo with explicit source/send inclusion modes. These modes affect more than just the visible solo button.

fl_arm_track.purpose: Legacy one-shot arm toggle. Prefer fl_recording_inspect plus fl_recording_arm for an exact desired recording state.

fl_ensure_mixer_tracks.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Appending mixer inserts has no backend implementation. Use native mixer tools with existing track indices.

fl_mixer_controls_inspect.purpose: Inspect built-in mixer EQ and strip switches with revision evidence, rather than treating them as plugin controls.

fl_mixer_controls_set.purpose: Guarded native changes to built-in EQ and polarity/swap/effect switches. Inputs are normalized even when reads report Hz or dB.

fl_mixer_meter_watch.purpose: Observe bounded peak-meter behavior over time. Useful for activity/clipping evidence; it does not replace integrated loudness or listening.

fl_routing_inspect.purpose: Inspect the complete mixer routing graph and obtain the revision needed for a guarded route edit.

fl_routing_scene.purpose: Preferred sends/buses/sidechain routing workflow. Zero-level enabled routes carry sidechain signals, and receiving-plugin configuration remains separate.

fl_is_plugin_valid.purpose: Check whether a generator/effect exists at an exact location before querying its controls.

fl_get_plugin_name.purpose: Read the current plugin name; identical names alone do not uniquely identify plugin state or binary version.

fl_get_plugin_color.purpose: Read host label color; this is metadata rather than sound information.

fl_get_preset_count.purpose: Read the preset count the plugin exposes to FL; not every internal preset browser is represented.

fl_get_plugin_param_count.purpose: Read the number of exposed parameters before a bounded inspection.

fl_get_plugin_param_value.purpose: Read one normalized parameter plus its literal display string.

fl_get_plugin_params.purpose: Read a bounded parameter set. Useful for narrow inspection without printing an entire large plugin catalog.

fl_plugin_parameters.purpose: Search/paginate exposed parameters, omitting empty VST padding. Prefer a query over dumping every parameter.

fl_plugin_inspect.purpose: Preferred indexed-plugin inspection: exact generator/effect context, all-state revision and a filtered parameter page.

fl_plugin_apply.purpose: Preferred guarded indexed-control write when working in normalized values. Bind names/revision and verify expected displays; uncertainty stops replay.

fl_plugin_adapter_catalog.purpose: Find packaged named-control profiles and calibration evidence before assuming physical-unit support.

fl_plugin_controls_inspect.purpose: Preferred named-control read for a recognized exact layout. Returns physical-unit availability and conditions without probing or changing sound.

fl_plugin_controls_set.purpose: Preferred calibrated physical-value or enum write. Change a mode selector separately, reinspect, then edit controls dependent on that mode.

fl_set_plugin_param_value.purpose: Basic single normalized parameter setter. Prefer named calibrated controls for ms/Hz/dB and the guarded batch for coordinated changes.

fl_plugin_set_many.purpose: Legacy normalized bulk setter with identity checks. Its verification guarantees are narrower than fl_plugin_apply.

fl_plugin_set_display_value.purpose: Actively probe a continuous parameter toward a displayed physical value. This is a write/calibration operation, not a harmless read.

fl_mix_profile.purpose: Apply a reusable group of named plugin controls with preflight and a recovery profile. Inspect its specific contract instead of assuming full new-adapter guarantees.

fl_next_preset.purpose: Advance one host-exposed preset. This changes sound and may not correspond to the plugin internal browser.

fl_prev_preset.purpose: Move back one host-exposed preset; use observed identity and preserve valuable sound edits.

fl_effect_add.purpose: Load an exact effect file/name into an empty slot through the native backend and verify the loaded plugin.

fl_plugin_add.purpose: Load an exact effect into an empty slot through the experimental native backend and verify its identity.

fl_plugin_chain.purpose: Load several effects serially with a receipt for each verified slot. It is not an all-or-nothing rollback transaction.

fl_plugin_remove.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Removing a loaded plugin has no backend implementation. Native controls can inspect and adjust an existing plugin.

fl_background_effect_inspect.purpose: Inspect the experimental background effect target: an empty slot on the already selected visible mixer strip.

fl_background_effect_load.purpose: Load one .fst via the experimental background route with one-shot dispatch and later identity checks. Selection and window prerequisites are strict.

fl_serum_recipes.purpose: Discover supported kick, 808, lead and pad templates and their editable settings before building a preset.

fl_serum_inspect.purpose: Read the 43 supported named Serum controls and confirm live mappings; do not infer unknown FX topology from these controls.

fl_serum_apply.purpose: Apply supported Serum controls in physical units with its own preflight/readback/rollback contract. This differs from the generic no-auto-rollback workflow.

fl_serum_inspect_preset.purpose: Read a supported native Serum preset file, including routing/envelopes and container checks. This is file evidence, not proof of a live loaded sound.

fl_serum_build_preset.purpose: Generate a new native preset from supported templates without opening FL. A valid file still needs loading and audition.

fl_serum_edit_preset.purpose: Create a modified preset copy while preserving unrelated DSP fields. Useful when a live host cache cannot be trusted.

fl_serum_load_preset.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Direct live loading of .SerumPreset files has no backend implementation. Use offline Serum preset tools, or fl_preset_load for an existing FL .fst preset.

fl_serum_probe.purpose: Audition one temporary note and record system-loopback audio for measurement. Other application audio can contaminate the probe.

fl_serum_analyze_audio.purpose: Measure pitch/harmonics/activity for a rendered or probed sound. It cannot certify perceptual similarity or musical quality.

fl_find_assets.purpose: Search bounded local asset roots for exact sample, preset and plugin paths. Resolve duplicate names before loading.

fl_sample_add.purpose: Load a WAV sample into a new sampler through the native backend.

fl_instrument_add.purpose: Load a generator FST into a new Channel Rack channel through the native backend.

fl_preset_load.purpose: Load a plugin FST using the native backend with guarded channel or mixer targets.

fl_audio_clip_add.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Creating a new Playlist audio channel has no backend implementation. Saved-FLP edits can reuse existing audio channels.

fl_audio_inspect.purpose: First read for an audio file: identity/hash, duration, levels and stereo/silence evidence. Use its source hash for subsequent guarded file edits.

fl_audio_bpm.purpose: Estimate fixed tempo and half/double-time candidates from WAV audio. A ranking is not a guaranteed musical tempo and never updates project BPM.

fl_audio_key.purpose: Estimate a global major/minor key with relative candidate confidence. It does not detect every modulation or tune the vocal automatically.

fl_audio_loudness.purpose: Measure full-file integrated loudness and true peaks through FFmpeg. Prefer it over raw RMS for delivery-level checks.

fl_audio_compare.purpose: Compare measured levels/stereo statistics against a reference. It does not time-align files or measure perceptual likeness.

fl_mix_diagnose.purpose: Turn rendered-file measurements into explicit gain proposals. It does not diagnose EQ/compression by track name or apply mastering.

fl_audio_edit.purpose: Make a new WAV with reviewed trim/reverse/fade/gain edits and exact readback. The original remains untouched, but cue/loop metadata is not preserved.

fl_project_native_inspect.purpose: Read native project title/revision without desktop input. The title cannot prove an absolute project path or saved bytes.

fl_project_save_native.purpose: Background save with host clean-state evidence. Distinguish its host-only guarantee from exact-path filesystem verification.

fl_project_info.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Dialog-based exact project-path discovery is unavailable. Use fl_project_native_inspect for native project state; the absolute path remains caller-declared.

fl_project_save.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Dialog-based exact-path saving is unavailable. Use fl_project_save_native to save the current named project.

fl_project_save_as.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Saving the active project under a new name has no backend implementation. Use fl_project_save_native for an already named project.

fl_project_open.purpose: Open a verified FLP after first preserving current edits in a new recovery file. It is a guarded project replacement, not a casual read.

fl_project_settings.purpose: Guarded BPM/shuffle edits. It does not provide general PPQ or time-signature editing.

fl_project_file_inspect.purpose: Read patterns, notes, Playlist and sample references from a saved FLP. Unsaved live edits are outside this snapshot.

fl_project_package.purpose: Bundle a saved project and referenced media into a new folder with hashes. It cannot include commercial plugin binaries or licenses.

fl_playlist_file_inspect.purpose: Read saved clip identities, tick positions and tracks before arrangement edits.

fl_playlist_file_edit.purpose: Write a new FLP with exact supported clip placement changes. Preserve source offsets/opaque data; arbitrary trims/stretching and new note content are outside this tool.

fl_automation_file_inspect.purpose: Read saved automation curves and hashes. Point ticks are local to each clip rather than global song time.

fl_automation_file_edit.purpose: Edit existing saved curves into a new FLP with normalized values and explicit segment modes. Reopen the new file only after review.

fl_automation_create_channel.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Creating a new automation link has no backend implementation. Use automation inspection and saved-FLP editing for existing automation.

fl_automation_target_inspect.purpose: Resolve the real native event ID and label for a specific channel, mixer or plugin target before attaching automation.

fl_automation_links_inspect.purpose: Read exact saved link identities with bounded results. Useful for diagnosing a curve that controls the wrong parameter.

fl_automation_file_retarget.purpose: Redirect one verified saved automation link into a new FLP, preserving its curve and placement. Target identity, file hash and link layout must all match.

fl_recording_inspect.purpose: Read arm/path metadata and fresh target revisions. It explicitly cannot establish input-device, buffer or latency configuration.

fl_recording_arm.purpose: Set a desired recording arm state once with later verification. Prefer this to the legacy toggle.

fl_recording_configure_file.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Setting a recording filename has no backend implementation. Use native recording inspection and arm controls for existing targets.

fl_recording_start.purpose: Start a bounded owned recording worker after manual/input prerequisites and fresh inspection. A queued job is not a verified take.

fl_recording_status.purpose: Read persistent job and decoded-take evidence. Check transport-stop and recorded_take_verified fields rather than interpreting success alone.

fl_recording_stop.purpose: Ask the owned recording worker to stop early. Poll status afterward; writing a stop request does not prove FL has stopped.

fl_render_start.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Starting a render has no backend implementation. fl_render_status can observe an existing render.

fl_render_status.purpose: Poll a render through completion and file/decode verification. Only the verified terminal state establishes completed output.

fl_render_cancel.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Cancelling a render has no backend implementation. fl_render_status can observe an existing render.

fl_batch.purpose: Execute documented typed operations after preflight. Fewer round trips help, but partial application stops without universal rollback.

fl_native_call.purpose: Expert escape hatch for an advertised FL native function. Positional arguments and an allow_write flag do not replace workflow-specific identity/recovery guards.

fl_ui_inspect.purpose: Inspect FL-owned windows and semantic controls; request screenshots/OCR only as needed. Returned observations are short-lived targeting evidence.

fl_ui_action.purpose: Unavailable in backend-only SyncFL. Desktop input is unavailable. Use native backend operations; fl_ui_inspect provides observation only.

fl_project_create.purpose: Create and load a named FL26 project from the clean unnamed Empty project before adding sounds or notes. Performs the first save through the backend; never ask the user to save a blank project manually.

fl_undo_status.purpose: Read FL's own undo counters and the last undoable action name.

fl_undo.purpose: Step FL's native undo stack back once; the undone action may not be the last tool call.

fl_clear_dialog.purpose: Close FL's active popup menu without desktop input; needs FL_MCP_ACCESS=full.

fl_plugin_mix.purpose: Read or set one effect slot's wet/dry level with readback.

fl_track_slots.purpose: Read or set a mixer strip's whole effect rack on/off with readback.

fl_event_inspect.purpose: Read a native automation event's labels, raw value and smoothed value.

fl_automate_event.purpose: Preview/apply one native automation event write and verify it by readback.

fl_rename_channel.purpose: Rename a Channel Rack channel by global index with readback.

fl_rename_pattern.purpose: Rename a pattern by index with readback.

fl_pattern_color.purpose: Read or set a pattern's native color word with readback.
